entries.name: highway-controls
entries.description: Manages the repository-wide Control baseline, adding, updating, removing and replacing the Controls that govern the repository.
entries.usage: Invoke as `/highway-controls` and state what to change, for example `/highway-controls add a control requiring administrative access to use MFA`.

entries.name: highway-help
entries.description: Prints registration details for one named skill, or a discovery listing of every registered skill when none is named.
entries.usage: Invoke as `/highway-help` for all skills, or `/highway-help <skill-id>` for one named skill's registration details.

entries.name: highway-inquiry
entries.description: Manages the requirements discovery questionnaire that Highway skills ask from, adding, changing, removing and reordering its questions on request.
entries.usage: Invoke as `/highway-inquiry` and state what to change, for example `/highway-inquiry add a question about data retention`.

entries.name: highway-nfrs
entries.description: Manages the repository-wide Non-Functional Requirement baseline; use it to add, update, remove, replace, or inspect NFRs.
entries.usage: Invoke as `/highway-nfrs` and state the NFR baseline change in plain language.

entries.name: highway-objectives
entries.description: Manages the repository-wide Business Objective baseline and its stable traceability references.
entries.usage: Invoke as `/highway-objectives` and state whether to inspect, add, update, remove, or reset Business Objectives.

entries.name: highway-profile
entries.description: Manages the repository-wide organizational profile that supplies contextual guidance without becoming governance.
entries.usage: Invoke as `/highway-profile` to inspect profile context, or state `setup`, `view`, `add`, `update`, `remove`, or `reset` and the intended profile change.

entries.name: highway-relationships
entries.description: Inspects and repairs repository-wide Control-to-NFR relationship integrity with explicit confirmation.
entries.usage: Invoke as `/highway-relationships` and state Inspect, Repair, or Impact followed by the governance relationship scope.
